_derivation: CONSTRUCTED from the lockout branch of AuthService.login and User.recordLoginFailure. NOT a live capture.

_lockout.counter_reset: only on successful login; NOT on lock expiry, so the next wrong password re-locks immediately

_rate_limit: MISSING. No rate limiter applies to /api/v1/auth/login (the only rate-limit filter is for /r/** and /report/**). There is no 429 and no Retry-After for auth endpoints, so this 401 body is the exact same contract as login-invalid-credentials.json.
_note: While locked, every attempt returns this body without extending the lock and is audited as LOGIN_LOCKED.
title: Unauthorized
